* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Set 19 release; card image first published 10 August 2022<ref name="img-o-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual19-Light/large/fennrau.gif</code> as published 10 August 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/25528d7b73b5e6206de765d700504be693fc39da/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Light/large/fennrau.gif holotable commit 25528d7] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="cj-o">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/b9359fe795c72c5f0ce04fa7f4ffc85ee5028cab swccg-card-json commit b9359fe795] (10 August 2022): dating evidence only.</ref>: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. During battle, if another Mandalorian here, opponent's total power is -3. At the end of a battle here, may return Fenn Rau to hand to activate 2 Force (if Fenn Rau won a battle this turn, may also retrieve 1 Force).” No E mark. The image prints the pilot ability as the pilot icon and “3.”. Margin: “Local Defense”.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Fenn Rau (Errata)]]): PC errata of 30 December 2024; card image marked E1 published 30 December 2024, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set19Type.html Virtual Set 19 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual19-Light/large/fennrau.gif</code> as published 30 December 2024: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Light/large/fennrau.gif holotable commit 9d2c01e] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="cj-PC-E1">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/4da5a9ec5636a391e4113eba01c7463a1b42ba32 swccg-card-json commit 4da5a9ec56] (13 January 2025): dating evidence only.</ref>: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. During battle, if another Mandalorian here, opponent's total power is -2. Once per game, at the end of a battle here, may return Fenn Rau to hand to activate 2 Force (if Fenn Rau won a battle this turn, may also retrieve 1 Force).” The PC card data's errata note (errataDate 30 December 2024) quotes the original text. '''What changed:''' “opponent's total power is -3” became “-2”, and the return-to-hand ability became once per game (“Once per game, at the end of a battle here, may return Fenn Rau to hand …”). Stats unchanged. The card gained the E1 mark.
